output.summary: Perennial culinary herb native to tropical parts of the Americas. It has velvety, heart-shaped leaves and white flower spikes that rise like candles. Its fragrant leaves are used in Mexican cooking as wrappers and to flavour mole, eggs and soups.
output.edibilityNote: Fresh or dried leaves flavour Mexican foods and drinks, though drying reduces flavour and makes them too brittle for wrappers.
